# awscc_bcm_scheduled_report (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::BCM::ScheduledReport



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scheduled report.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the scheduled report was created.
- `dashboard_arn` (String) The ARN of the dashboard associated with the scheduled report. Managed dashboards cannot be used.
- `description` (String) A description of the scheduled report's purpose or contents.
- `health_status` (Attributes) The health status of the scheduled report at its last refresh time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_status))
- `name` (String) The name of the scheduled report.
- `schedule_config` (Attributes) The schedule configuration that defines when and how often the report is generated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule_config))
- `scheduled_report_execution_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that the scheduled report uses to execute. AWS Billing and Cost Management Dashboards assumes this IAM role while executing the scheduled report.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags applied to the scheduled report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the scheduled report was last modified.
- `widget_date_range_override` (Attributes) The date range override applied to widgets in the scheduled report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_date_range_override))
- `widget_ids` (List of String) The list of widget identifiers included in the scheduled report. If not specified, all widgets in the dashboard are included.

<a id="nestedatt--health_status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_status`

Read-Only:

- `last_refreshed_at` (String) The time at which the health status was last refreshed.
- `status_code` (String) Whether the scheduled report is healthy.


<a id="nestedatt--schedule_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_config`

Read-Only:

- `schedule_expression` (String) The schedule expression that specifies when to trigger the scheduled report run. This value must be a cron expression consisting of six fields separated by white spaces: cron(minutes hours day_of_month month day_of_week year).
- `schedule_expression_time_zone` (String) The time zone for the schedule expression, for example, UTC.
- `schedule_period` (Attributes) The time period during which the schedule is active. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule_config--schedule_period))
- `state` (String) The state of the schedule. ENABLED means the scheduled report runs according to its schedule expression. DISABLED means the scheduled report is paused and will not run until re-enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule_config--schedule_period"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_config.schedule_period`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (String) The time at which the schedule stops being active.
- `start_time` (String) The time at which the schedule becomes active.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.


<a id="nestedatt--widget_date_range_override"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_date_range_override`

Read-Only:

- `end_time` (Attributes) The end of the range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_date_range_override--end_time))
- `start_time` (Attributes) The start of the range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--widget_date_range_override--start_time))

<a id="nestedatt--widget_date_range_override--end_time"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_date_range_override.end_time`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Whether Value is an absolute date or a duration relative to now.
- `value` (String) The date, or an ISO 8601 duration when Type is RELATIVE.


<a id="nestedatt--widget_date_range_override--start_time"></a>
### Nested Schema for `widget_date_range_override.start_time`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Whether Value is an absolute date or a duration relative to now.
- `value` (String) The date, or an ISO 8601 duration when Type is RELATIVE.
